name: Secret of the Circle

faq.answer: The circle of statues rests inside the Sunken Temple.

aliases: what is hidden in the statues
faq.answer: You are searching for a hidden secret concealed within the circle of stone figures.
faq.q: What are you looking for among the statues?

faq.answer: They are stone carvings arranged in a ring deep inside the sunken corridors of the temple.
faq.q: What kind of statues make up the circle?

sections.body: A strange gathering of stone carvings stands silent inside the Sunken Temple. Whatever purpose binds these effigies together remains shrouded in mystery, and answering their riddle means walking right into the ancient ruin yourself.
sections.title: Into the Drowned Halls

summary: Deep within the Sunken Temple lies a mysterious circle of stone figures. You are venturing into the submerged halls to uncover whatever mystery is concealed among the statues.
attribution: In-game quest text: Secret of the Circle
